stem: How did Charles Lindbergh affect the development of aviation in the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: Lindbergh showed that air travel was an acceptable form of transportation.

options.label: B
options.text: Lindbergh lobbied Congress to invest federal funding into commercial airlines.

options.label: C
options.text: Lindbergh demonstrated aerial maneuvers that could provide the military with an advantage.

options.label: D
options.text: Lindbergh created the first domestic commercial airline company.
